_comment: Bewertung bekannter Schwachstellen von Komponenten, aus denen der E-Rechnung Prüfer abgeleitet ist oder die er enthält (Art. 13 Abs. 6 und 7 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/2847: Schwachstellen systematisch dokumentieren). Quelle von vex.cdx.json (tools/make-vex.cjs; CycloneDX 1.6 VEX, getrennt von der Stückliste, BSI TR-03183-2 3.1 und 8.1.14). Jeder Eintrag: Kennung, betroffene Komponente (bom-ref der Stückliste), Zustand und Begründung nach CycloneDX (impactAnalysisState, impactAnalysisJustification), Prüfung. Neue Meldungen der Schwachstellenprüfung (Workflow security, OSV-Scanner) werden hier bewertet. Stand der Prüfung: firstIssued/lastUpdated. csafRevisions: Revisionen des CSAF-VEX-Dokuments je Version (tools/make-csaf.cjs); jede Änderung einer Bewertung braucht eine neue Revision der aktuellen Version.

statements.description: XMLSchemaValidator of Xerces (JAXP) did not enforce the feature use-grammar-pool-only: a crafted document could make the validator load and use a schema grammar named by the document (same flaw as CVE-2020-14621 in OpenJDK).
statements.detail: src/xsd-validator.js follows the assessment order of XMLSchemaValidator but contains no grammar loading at all: it validates only against the schema models compiled from the official XSDs and embedded in the page; xsi:schemaLocation and xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation are accepted and never followed (no resolver, no network access – Content-Security-Policy connect-src 'none'). A root element without declaration is reported as cvc-elt.1.a, as by the fixed Xerces with use-grammar-pool-only. The OpenJDK 21 sources it follows contain the fix of CVE-2020-14621.

statements.description: The Xerces-J XML parser enters an infinite loop on specially crafted XML document payloads.
statements.detail: The flaw is in the XML scanner of Xerces. src/xsd-validator.js contains no XML parser: it validates a DOM that the browser's own parser (DOMParser) or, in the Node tests, slimdom produced; no code of the Xerces scanner was translated. Hostile XML is additionally bounded by the refusal of document type declarations and the nesting limit (src/pruefer-core.js, suite robustness).

statements.description: XMLscanner.java in Apache Xerces2 Java Parser before 2.12.0 allows a denial of service via vectors related to XML attribute names.
statements.detail: The flaw is in XMLScanner (parsing of attribute names). src/xsd-validator.js contains no XML scanner or parser; it validates an already parsed DOM.

statements.description: Apache Xerces2 Java Parser before 2.12.0 allows a denial of service (CPU consumption) via a crafted message that triggers hash table collisions.
statements.detail: The flaw is in the parser's symbol table (hash collisions of names). src/xsd-validator.js contains neither the parser nor its symbol table; names are compared as JavaScript strings in Map objects of the JavaScript engine.

statements.description: XMLScanner.java in Apache Xerces2 Java allows a denial of service (infinite loop and application hang) via malformed XML input.
statements.detail: The flaw is in XMLScanner. src/xsd-validator.js contains no XML scanner or parser; malformed XML is rejected by the browser's parser before validation (suite robustness, robustness-browser-*).
